reviews.title: Great replacement for light use PC
reviews.comment: It serves it purpose. Replaced a 2080 Ti in a pc that has become my media pc for the living room. As this pc was not for gaming but for media use and occasional server use, it did not need to be a beefed up card. For the price this could not be beat.
